pillar: AI tools that change marketing work

slides.title: Your website URL is now *an ad brief*
slides.subtitle: Google, X and Meta now draft ads from what you already have

slides.label: 01 · Google
slides.title: URLs and photos into video
slides.body: Google says Asset Studio, powered by *Gemini Omni*, turns your website URLs and photos into videos you can preview before publishing. For Demand Gen and YouTube ads.

slides.label: 02 · X
slides.title: X Lift builds the whole campaign
slides.body: Enter your URL. X's AI offers images and copy, and can build the campaign, *targeting included*. You set the budget. It's aimed at new advertisers.

slides.label: 03 · Meta
slides.title: Static ads become video
slides.body: Advantage+ creative now generates video from static assets, *generally available*. Ads Creative Studio can change hooks, audio, clip length, captions and end scenes.

slides.label: Who X Lift is for
slides.title: growth in X's active self-serve advertisers
slides.body: Q3 2026 vs Q3 2025, as reported by X. Smaller, newer advertisers are the target.

slides.label: 04 · Fix the page first
slides.title: The AI reads your landing page
slides.body: Put the offer, the price and the proof near the top. A vague page gives you *a vague ad*, just faster.

slides.label: 05 · Keep a control
slides.title: AI draft vs your best ad
slides.body: Same budget, same audience, one variable. Google's own advice: change gradually and judge *quality over quantity*, so the system has time to measure.

slides.label: The catch
slides.title: Keep a human on spend
slides.body: X Lift can set targeting for you. Meta is adding budget changes *by prompt*. Let AI draft the options. You decide what's true and worth the money.

slides.title: Save this before your next *campaign launch*.
slides.subtitle: Full breakdown on Build with Vish.
